ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition and Advertising majors on Monday, November 13, 2017 and to business minors on Monday, November 20, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Technical Systems Management, ISE and French Commercial students on Monday, November 27, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 30 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 19, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technical Systems Management or Food Science & Human Nutrition or Curric Unassigned or Accountancy or Finance or General Engineering or Industrial Engineering or Advertising or Marketing or French Commercial Studies or Management or Business or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Systems Engineering and Design or Operations Management or Information Systems major(s) or minor(s).
